deathSays.line: 📖 LEARNED: Grave Robber (Level 2). The dead don't mind. Much.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Ada Jang. Mortician. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dead Phone, Marked Bus Map, Dispatcher's headset, Photo album, Seed packet. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walked past the treeline on two legs. Too tall. It stopped. It listened. Then it kept going. Nobody slept after that.

🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 40s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A crow that watches too long and blinks too little — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the woman in her 30s, with ink-stained fingers says "We've been walking past those." Marisol mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
Someone in your party saw it happen. Pavel is dead. They tell you straight.
◈ CRISIS — THE FIRST GRAVE. Pavel is dead. The village digs its first grave, and everyone understands at once: this place can kill you. It just did.

◈ "UNIT DEAD PHONE — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Dead Phone
Cracked screen, 2% forever. The last text, unsent: 'call when you can.' It was from Iván — your brother. You have carried the unsent message for years. Maybe he is still out there.
💛 The Dead Phone is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
Movement — a crow watching you from a dead branch, head cocked.
★ IDENTIFIED: Peanut. Groundnut. Low bush, nuts buried under it. Dig them up. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
